hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r TARGET; case "$TARGET" in *.env|*.env.*|*credentials.*|*secrets.*|*.pem|*.key|*.p12|*.pfx|*id_rsa*|*id_ed25519*) echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Blocked: refusing to write to sensitive file (' "$TARGET" '). Confirm with the user before bypassing."}' ;; *) echo '{}' ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r EDITED_FILE; case "$EDITED_FILE" in */charts/types.ts|*/charts/registry.ts|*/types/data.ts|*/stores/*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"STATE-SENSITIVE FILE EDITED. Verify: (1) ChartDefinition/ChartRenderer interface changes propagate to all existing chart implementations. (2) DataSet/DataView/ColumnMeta changes propagate to shape-detector and transforms. (3) Store changes propagate to consuming components. (4) Cross-check against AGENTS.md §6 Data Contracts — these changes require a master-plan update and a major semver bump."}}' ;; */charts/renderers/*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"RENDERER FILE EDITED. Verify: (1) WebGL cleanup on unmount (deck.gl/regl). (2) Theme tokens applied. (3) ChartArea still keys on chartType so switches trigger unmount."}}' ;; *) ;; esac; }

echo '=== SESSION END CHECK ===' && CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null) && STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null) && if [ -n "$CHANGED" ] || [ -n "$STAGED" ]; then echo 'UNCOMMITTED CHANGES DETECTED:' && echo "$CHANGED" && echo "$STAGED" && echo '' && echo 'Verification commands (Claude does NOT commit — user handles git):' && echo '  npm run typecheck' && echo '  npm run lint' && echo '  npm run test:coverage'; else echo 'No uncommitted changes.'; fi

echo '{"systemMessage":"SESSION END — MEMORY REVIEW: Before this session closes, review what was learned and suggest memories the user may want to save. Check ~/.codex/memories/-Users-amrambouskila-IMPORTANT-Projects-business-intelligence/memory/MEMORY.md first to avoid duplicates — update existing memories rather than creating new ones when the topic already exists. Memory types: user (role, preferences, knowledge), feedback (corrections given, confirmed approaches — include WHY), project (decisions with external motivation, deadlines, stakeholder context), reference (pointers to external systems). Worth saving: corrections the user gave you, non-obvious approaches they confirmed, project decisions driven by external factors, pointers to external tools/systems, user preferences learned this session. NOT worth saving: anything derivable from code or git history, debugging solutions, ephemeral task details, things already in AGENTS.md. Present a short bulleted list of suggested memories at the end of your response and let the user decide which to save. Memory dir: ~/.codex/memories/-Users-amrambouskila-IMPORTANT-Projects-business-intelligence/memory/"}'
